story.label: 07 / The clinic
story.title: A calm environment is part of the treatment.
paragraphs: While designing the clinic we kept returning to one question: how does an animal feel inside this room?
Light, sound, smell, pace — each one changes an examination. So we chose consistency over speed.
Every visit ends with a written summary: what was checked, why, and what happens next.

pillars.title: Written summary
pillars.body: A plan you can read again at home.

pillars.title: One doctor
pillars.body: A specialist who knows your animal.

booking.title: Booking
booking.lead: Ten steps. Each question is asked only when it matters.

animal.question: What brings you here today?
animal.lead: We start with the animal — that keeps every following question relevant.
animal.catNote: Calm room, low-stress exam, urinary health.

pet.lead: Pets saved in your account. Or add a new one.
pet.name: Name
pet.skipHint: You can continue without the details — we fill them in at the visit.

reason.question: Why do you need a visit?
reason.hint: If there are several reasons, pick the main one and mention the rest in a note.

questions.lead: The next question depends on your answer.

recommendation.label: Recommendation
recommendation.title: Based on what you told us, this visit type may be appropriate.
recommendation.urgentNote: These signs may require prompt veterinary attention. Please contact the clinic as soon as possible.
recommendation.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis. A final conclusion is only possible after an examination.

reasons.checkup: A routine exam keeps prevention aligned with age and breed.
reasons.vaccination: Vaccination starts with a plan based on previous vaccinations.
reasons.injury: An injury needs an examination first, and diagnostics if required.
reasons.skin: Skin signs call for a dermatological exam and diagnostics if needed.
reasons.dental: Signs in the mouth begin with a dental examination.
reasons.nutrition: Nutrition needs weight, age and overall health looked at together.
reasons.surgery: Before a procedure we plan an examination and preparation.
reasons.other: When the cause is unclear, a general consultation is the calmest start.

something_wrong.not_eating: Loss of appetite has many causes — a general consultation is the starting point.
something_wrong.vomiting: The length of vomiting and the risk of dehydration are assessed during the exam.
something_wrong.diarrhea: The duration of diarrhoea and any blood are assessed during the exam.
something_wrong.coughing: Finding the cause of a cough takes an exam and, if needed, diagnostics.
something_wrong.breathing: Breathing difficulty is not something to postpone.
something_wrong.pain: Locating pain starts with an examination and checks.
something_wrong.low_energy: Low energy can involve many systems — a general consultation is needed.
something_wrong.skin: Skin signs begin with a dermatological examination.
something_wrong.behavior: A behaviour change often has a physical cause — an exam is needed.
something_wrong.other: When the cause is unclear, a general consultation is the calmest start.
